CustomObject.description: Published by the FIMBY_Sign_Up_Private screen flow (guest user) after it creates a Contact. The subscriber (CommunityUserProvisionEventTrigger -> FimbyCommunityUserProvisionHandler) runs as an admin via PlatformEventSubscriberConfig and creates the Customer Community User in a separate transaction, avoiding guest permission limits and MIXED_DML_OPERATION. Publish After Commit so the event only fires once the Contact exists.
CustomObject.label: Community User Provision Event
